# Playpass

> Sports management platform for organizing leagues, tournaments, and recreational sports with registration, scheduling, waivers, and payment tools.

Playpass provides privacy-first software for sports organizations, clubs, and leagues to manage activities, registrations, and schedules. The platform includes developer APIs with OAuth authentication and serves organizations across soccer, basketball, volleyball, chess, and other recreational sports.

## Key Topics

- League Management
- Sports Registration
- Scheduler
- Waivers
- Recreational Sports
- Organization Profiles
- Playpass API
- OAuth Authentication
- Soccer Leagues
- Tournament Management
- Payment Processing
- Sports Management Software
- Activity Publishing
- Team Scheduling

## Getting Started

- [About Playpass](https://playpass.com/about): Company overview, mission, privacy-first sports management platform
- [Playpass for Players](https://playpass.com/players): Player portal for viewing schedules, registration, and payments
- [Support](https://playpass.com/support): Help center with guides for Scheduler, Registration, and other features

## Support & FAQs

- [Help & FAQs](https://playpass.com/support/help-faqs): FAQ hub covering staff management, publishing, API, and billing
- [Account and Billing FAQ](https://playpass.com/support/help-faqs/account-and-billing-faq): FAQ for pricing, free trial, billing, and account management
- [Publishing FAQ](https://playpass.com/support/help-faqs/publishing-faq): FAQ on publishing schedules, activities, and content lifecycle

## Developer Resources

- [Developers API Guide](https://playpass.com/support/help-faqs/developers-api): Playpass API documentation with OAuth and token authentication guide

## Blog & Guides

- [Playpass Blog](https://playpass.com/blog): Blog with sports management tips and league organization advice
- [How to Organize a Recreational Sports League](https://playpass.com/blog/how-to-organize-a-recreational-sports-league): Guide to organizing recreational sports leagues for beginners
